content.summary: Three skeptical fidelity challenges found no lost quantifier, sign or material caveat. Newly inspected pages 1, 4, 5, 6 and 9 complete visual coverage of the unchanged eleven-page preview across rounds six and seven. This supports preview fidelity, not proof correctness or publication approval.

findings.statement: The unchanged page-7/page-8 lead-in split remains readable.
All eleven pages of this exact preview have now been inspected across two rounds.
findings.disposition: Full preview visual coverage does not establish final approval, semantic tagging or accessibility conformance.

revisions.action: Inspect corrected notation on page 4 and verify unchanged bytes.
revisions.result: Earlier formula and parsing repairs persist.

revisions.action: Verify source identity with the previously checked definition.
revisions.result: The explicit neighbourhood distinction is unchanged.

checks.scope: Challenge: rendering strengthens quantifiers or drops guards
checks.method: Inspect pages 1 and 6; compare HTML/PDF guard tokens with committed Alpha round-three and round-five boundary tests.
checks.observation: The abstract says every fifteen-triple family has a member with seven disjoint companions; rho remains a maximum. The forcing threshold remains 68. Assume rho <= 6, exact rho = 7, permitted p0i and b[i] <= 27 survive extraction, preserving distinctions made necessary by Alpha's rho=8 and independence-cap-28 examples.

checks.scope: Challenge: lost signs convert equality or infeasibility into exclusion
checks.method: Actually inspect pages 4–6 against source formulas and extracted text.
checks.observation: Strict target comparison and equality-is-not-exclusion remain explicit. The value-49 case is not rounded down. Negative numerators -406255021 and -3584828830, scale 10^10, and sibling independence remain visible. The P10 comparison retains W >= 240 versus W <= 234.

checks.scope: Challenge: rendered caveats disappear or imply stronger certification
checks.method: Inspect page 9; compare limitation tokens in HTML/PDF with committed Alpha's external-tree distinction; verify unchanged manuscript and preview hashes.
checks.observation: Shared model construction, absent end-to-end Lean closure and absent independent human certification remain explicit. The returned-listing/root-mismatch qualification remains present in the unchanged Section 2. Hashes match. No local rendering or review count is presented as re-establishing H27; I did not rerun Alpha's mathematical tests.
